name: Skull

categories.label: Successful challenges
categories.labelVi: Số lần thách đấu thành công
categories.hint: Flip the mat (roses side) each time you win a challenge; 2 wins ends the game.

categories.label: Won the game
categories.hint: Won by 2 successful challenges, or by being the last player with cards left.

winCondition: A player wins by succeeding at a challenge twice (flipping their mat twice), or by being the only player not eliminated. Failing a challenge costs one disc; a player with no discs is eliminated.

endCondition.description: Each player starts with 4 discs (3 roses, 1 skull); play ends at a 2nd successful challenge by one player or when one player remains.

notes: family: elimination-bluff. No points. Not verified against the official rulebook PDF (could not retrieve it); based on Wikipedia and the UltraBoardGames rules text. Skull & Roses Red (two gangs per player) uses the same win rules.
